clarifications.text: Public pretrained DINOv2/DINOv3 is permitted when the final model is trained on official train.
A frozen backbone with a train-data classifier head is permitted transfer learning.
Official training samples may be omitted and train preprocessing/augmentation is permitted; no external data may be added.
Incorrectly labeled training samples may be deleted; preprocessing may do anything except add external data.
Test pseudo-labeling or any test-driven parameter update is prohibited.
All 1,458 current test images are scored, without public/private split.
Finalists will be verified on a new unseen test set.
Only three preliminary submissions are allowed.
Use 20 selected teams, superseding an earlier mention of 22.
Cleaning must be reproducible and explainable for verification.
